                 body: "Reports: cr_1e2ea0 (x2, POST /v1/reminders/rem_0001/done) and cr_ee551c (GET /v1/reminders/rem_0001), v1.4.0 (commit 9c41e7a).\n\nCause: store/store.go (*Store).Get. For a tombstoned (Deleted) reminder it sets r = nil but leaves err nil, so it returns (nil, nil). Its doc says \"Deleted reminders are not returned\". api/reminders.go:144 in (*API).owned then does rem.UserID on the nil pointer. Every caller that checks only err (api/reminders.go:139, api/lists.go:56, api/search.go:31) is exposed the same way.\n\nSequence in the logs: rem_0001 was created at 14:09:46, deleted at 14:11:02 (204), then done/get requests hit it and panicked.\n\nFix: Get returns (nil, ErrNotFound) for deleted reminders, matching the missing-ID case. Reproducer: store TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound (create, delete, Get must return ErrNotFound and a nil reminder). It fails on v1.4.0 code and passes with the change."
  tool result: filed #103

                 body: "Triage: report cr_f9ee9e (3 occurrences, fp_6b14b3, v1.4.0). Request: POST /v1/reminders with header \"Authorization: Bearer\" (no space or token). Cause: auth/auth.go (parseBearer) checks only HasPrefix \"Bearer\", then does strings.SplitN(h, \" \", 2)[1], which panics when there is no space. Verified fix: use strings.CutPrefix(h, \"Bearer \") and reject an empty token. I applied this and a reproducer test passed on the fix and failed on v1.4.0, then reverted it because this issue already covers the crash and I did not want to change code under a duplicate. Ready to apply."
